FROM YOUR PLAN TO 4D

Try your law office in AR.

  1. Print the updated tracking sheet. The previous sample-house sheet will no longer work.
  2. Open this app directly in Safari or Chrome on your phone. The AR camera opens automatically; allow camera access. If your browser requires a tap, use Start AR camera.
  3. Keep the full plan flat, evenly lit, and in view. This version uses 8th Wall image tracking.
  4. The complete building appears first. Press Play to restart construction; the first 21 workdays are schedule-only. The full sequence takes about 25 seconds at 1× while the sheet is tracked. Playback waits when tracking is lost. Use Retry AR if needed.

The QR code opens the app. The plan anchors the model. The Gantt stays on screen. Use Hide roof & upper slab to inspect the interior.

This is your imported Revit model with teaching colors. Durations are assumptions. Foundations, the primary frame, and MEP systems were not identified in the export. Their activities remain visible in the schedule.
